verdict.rationale: RUN has a few of its own batch-style capabilities: AI-powered import of employee hours from an existing timesheet file, recurring payroll that pays all employees automatically, automatic direct deposit to each employee, and journal-entry export to accounting tools. These are bulk operations, but only within fixed payroll workflows; nothing shows user-directed bulk edits or actions across many records. API Central is a developer building block and earns no credit here. Missing for 10: general-purpose bulk edit/update of employee or payroll records, documented bulk actions beyond timesheet import and payroll runs, AI-driven bulk operations, independent or hands-on corroboration.
